title: Frame30 Universal Verification Mould (DICE) Stage 2.1: Integrity Remediation, Dependency Resolution & CI Gate Authorization
objective: Formalize the Stage 2.1 integrity remediation scope, dependency authorization, and CI integration. Authorizes dynamic contract resolution in scripts/scope-guard.mjs and the integration of the dice-qualification gate into .circleci/config.yml, authorizes ajv@^8.17.1 and ajv-formats@^3.0.1 in package.json and bun.lock for JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation, relocates multi-surface extractor fixtures to tests/fixtures/dice/ with zero @ts-nocheck directives, establishes dedicated tsconfig.dice.json, enforces non-synthesizing dry-run bootstrap semantics, eliminates DSSE UTF-8 byte length flaws, mandates fail-closed duplicate receipt rejection (identical and conflicting), and establishes independent baseline validation and exact disjoint union partition in the qualification engine.
merchant_or_user_outcome: Guarantees that verification results across all merchant domains cannot be certified via synthetic PASS receipts or vacuous qualifications, ensuring zero-trust cryptographic assurance and robust CircleCI Linux Bubblewrap sandboxing.
problem_and_evidence: Stage 2 and 2.1 audits identified 8 critical issues: (1) scripts/dice-bootstrap.mjs synthesized simulated PASS receipts, (2) scripts/dice-evidence.mjs used UTF-16 character length instead of UTF-8 byte length for DSSE PAE, (3) qualification engine permitted identical duplicate receipts to pass, (4) qualification engine did not independently verify the 4 mandatory baseline obligations nor enforce the disjoint union partition Selected = Active ⊎ Waived and Mandatory ⊆ Active, (5) CI config and scope-guard modifications created circular scope without an attributable amendment contract, (6) dependency discrepancy where Ajv 8 was absent from worktree candidate files, (7) fixture files inside src/ necessitated @ts-nocheck suppressions, and (8) hostile execution containment required genuine Linux Bubblewrap.
behavioral_requirements: 1. Zero synthetic receipts: scripts/dice-bootstrap.mjs in --dry-run mode produces status DRY_RUN_NON_AUTHORITATIVE and strictly suppresses attestation envelope generation; active run mode executes authentic obligations and evaluates genuine receipts.

2. Interoperable DSSE PAE: scripts/dice-evidence.mjs computes DSSE Pre-Authentication Encoding using exact UTF-8 byte lengths for non-ASCII Unicode statements, adhering to RFC 8785 and DSSE protocol specifications.
3. Fail-closed duplicate receipt rejection: scripts/dice-qualify.mjs evaluates any duplicate receipts (identical or conflicting) as DISP_BLOCKED (DUPLICATE_RECEIPTS_PROHIBITED).

4. Independent plan integrity and partition validation: scripts/dice-qualify.mjs independently verifies that all 4 mandatory baseline obligations {OBL-SYS-SCOPE-GUARD-001, OBL-SYS-DRIFT-GUARD-001, OBL-SYS-DIE-REGISTRY-001, OBL-SYS-SECRETS-SCAN-001} are present in mandatory and selected sets, enforces uniqueness of all obligation IDs, and strictly enforces the mathematical partition invariants Selected = Active ⊎ Waived (Selected = Active ∪ Waived ∧ Active ∩ Waived = ∅) and Mandatory ⊆ Active, returning QUALIFIED_BLOCKED(PLAN_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION) on any violation.
5. Standardized OBL naming: All mandatory obligation identifiers conform to ^OBL-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9_-]+-[0-9]{3}$ using hyphens consistently across schemas, registries, contracts, and test fixtures.

6. CircleCI gate integration: Authorizes adding the dice-qualification job to .circleci/config.yml under CircleCI authority, ensuring authentic Linux Bubblewrap qualification is required before candidate merge.
7. Dependency reconciliation: Authorizes ajv@^8.17.1 and ajv-formats@^3.0.1 in package.json and bun.lock for normative Draft 2020-12 schema validation in development and test environments.

8. Fixture hygiene and dedicated TS configuration: Relocates test fixtures to tests/fixtures/dice/ without @ts-nocheck suppressions, and configures tsconfig.dice.json for strict isolated typechecking.
9. Stage 3 containment: Stage 3 mould self-verification remains strictly blocked until Stage 2.1 remediation is independently reviewed and authorized by @devrahmanbd.
forbidden_behaviors: 1. Synthesizing or fabricating PASS receipts in dry-run or active bootstrap execution.
2. Generating an authentic attestation envelope in dry-run mode.
3. Permitting duplicate receipts (identical or conflicting) to produce DISP_PASS.
4. Waiving mandatory baseline obligations or approving merge for candidates with QUALIFIED_WAIVED or QUALIFIED_BLOCKED status.
5. Permitting any violation of the obligation partition Selected = Active ⊎ Waived or Mandatory ⊆ Active.
6. Initiating Stage 3 mould self-verification prior to Stage 2.1 human authorization.
